blocks.text: Jonathan Sterling was in the audience when Celeste Cortesi walked the Manila Fashion Week runway for designer Chris Nick. But the support viewers saw came after an argument that nearly kept her from the show. “Celeste and I had an argument that day, and we were not on very good terms at that time,” Sterling said in Episode 5 of “Celeste Unscripted.” Titled “Friendship Not Over,” the episode follows Cortesi’s reconciliation with longtime friend Benj Sadac. Alongside that reunion, however, comes a frank account of strain in her relationship with Sterling — and the effort it took to keep their disagreement […]...
